title: Plugin health report (v1alpha1)
description: Response body of GET /plugin/v1/health. Two-signal model: live/ready for liveness/readiness, plus an optional functional watermark so 'process alive' is not mistaken for 'work happening' (the Wave-1 lesson). A busy long-running job reports progress via the watermark and MUST NOT read as degraded merely for being busy.

ready.description: Dependencies wired; can serve (readiness). Only ready plugins are proxied user traffic.

watermark.description: Functional progress signal. Stale past the plugin's declared watermarkBudget => degraded, even when ready:true.

lastProgressUnix.description: Unix seconds of the last real progress (event accepted, job succeeded).

detail.description: Optional human detail for ops surfaces.

reason.description: Optional reason when not ready (surfaced by the supervisor).
